notes.title: v1.0.9 - Crash Fix
notes.content: This should fix an edge case scenario when clicking would sometimes crash the game. Sorry about that!

notes.title: Achievement fix!
notes.content: This is a small patch to fix the achievements sometimes not being awarded.

notes.title: DOGS IS LIVE!
notes.content: Dogs is live, get to clicking and get some drops! Three drops a day, at twenty minute intervals. Go get 'em!

notes.title: Dogs launching soon!(tm)
notes.content:
Dogs is almost ready, we have item drops, we have an achievement but most importantly we have 36 dogs to click on! 

I hope to have Dogs ready to launch this week, or next week at the very latest. So stay tuned!
